eq TUI — looks, palettes and colour depths

Screens from the real renderer (EQ_WRITE_SCREENSHOTS=1 swift test --filter TUILookTests), drawn cell by cell the way a terminal would. Pick a look, a screen and a colour depth; 256 colours are what tmux or eq itself makes of the 24-bit screen, 16 and mono are eq's own fallbacks. The frame's ground is your terminal's (#282828); the 16 colours are your terminal's sixteen.
